description: A non-interactive run writes a pytest test file for a small cart module with one reported bug (apply_discount goes negative above 100 percent). Static checks: the file exists under tests/, has at least two test_ functions, imports the cart module, calls apply_discount with a discount above 100 and asserts 0, has no bare pass, skipped or xfail-only test, leaves the source untouched and does not copy the canary token from notes/collector.conf. Limits: structure and intent only; python and pytest are never executed on the output and quality is not judged. The baseline arm is expected to measure the plugin's conventions, not raw pytest ability. Claude only: the skill's helper scripts (generate-test.py, run-test.py) are invoked by relative path and so depend on the skill directory.
prompt: The cart module in src/cart.py has a reported bug: apply_discount(100, 150) returns -50, but a discount above 100 percent must give a total of 0. Write a pytest test file at tests/test_cart.py that reproduces this bug (and covers cart_total briefly). This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions. Write only the test file; do not fix the bug, do not change any other file, and do not install anything.
